examples.title: Find the requested middle code
examples.question: How many bins have been checked, and when can the clerk stop?
examples.setting: A workshop stores part codes 2, 4, 6, 8, 10, 12, 14 and 16 in bins numbered 1 through 8. A clerk receives a requested code. Move the comparison step to follow the checks, or change the requested code and predict the next bin. The bins are already sorted, so a middle comparison can eliminate half of the current candidates.
assumptions: The eight distinct even codes are already sorted. Sorting cost is excluded. One step is one three-way middle-bin comparison, not the number of primitive language operators. The lower middle bin is used when a window has even size.
